name: Breaker-and-a-half diameter arrangement
summary: Connects two circuits through the documented three-breaker diameter between buses.
description: Connects two circuits through the documented three-breaker diameter between buses. A busbar arrangement defines the available paths between incoming circuits, outgoing circuits and bus sections. Its switching devices and measurement boundaries determine how a circuit can remain connected when part of the installation is unavailable.

In a switchyard, a single-line arrangement helps identify the bay connections, tie devices and possible alternate supply paths. Normal open points must remain separate from the equipment's physical ability to close. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two circuits and three breakers” at the input and “Shared diameter supply paths” at the output. The middle breaker participates in two circuit paths.

The arrangement illustrates electrical connectivity; reliability, fault levels, permitted switching and protection coordination require the actual network design.
